    Questions

    Good to know

    How does my child start?

    Create a student account, pick the club, and start at the Beginner level. Each level ends with a short exam — pass it with 70% and the next level unlocks, along with a certificate.

    How do parents follow their child?

    Create a parent account, then enter the 6-character code from your child’s dashboard. You’ll see books read, exam results and teacher notes, and you can message the teachers directly.

    Can students see the private messages between parents and teachers?

    No. Parents and teachers can mark a message as private — those are visible only to the child’s parents and the teachers.

    How do teachers get an account?

    Teacher accounts are created by the academy. Teachers sign up normally and the admin gives them teacher access.

    Does it work on phones and in Arabic?

    Yes — the whole site, dashboard and chat work on any phone, tablet or computer, in both Arabic and English.
